t: How Base Models Have Become Cool | Capital One Auto Navigator
s: April 18, 2024 - A low-priced new car appealed to dealers, who might advertise such a model with a low monthly lease or purchase price to lure shoppers into the showroom. But a bare-bones 2018 Nissan Versa was not very compelling to buyers, aside from its position as the least expensive new vehicle a U.S. consumer could purchase at the time. It didn't even have power windows or door locks.
